title: Blueprint in the Glean Sales Process
body: Where Blueprint sits in the Glean opportunity stages, what unlocks it, stage exit criteria, and how it connects to MEDDPICCS and the business case
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Map Visioning, DITL and Executive Validation to Stages 2 and 3.
State what must be true to enter and exit Blueprint.
Apply prescribed remedial actions when exit criteria are not met.
Connect Blueprint outputs to MEDDPICCS fields.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-101. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
